title: The browser says agents are paused: the pause on /health/read, the Seats and shell banner, the board next-step, e2e and runbook
description:
SPIDR child 3 of task-2723a9b400984ab7b1b10f97c3523c81. dependsOn child 2 (task-4109c1a0e1154ca89576183dae7a5336), which dependsOn child 1 (task-756d81f117fb4ef6aeca2c676f433c91). Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d. Verify children first: `grep -n readProviderPause apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/provider-pause-ledger.ts`; `grep -n "provider limit" apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-wrapper*.ts`.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the read + the human-visible surfaces + the e2e + the runbook section. No wrapper change.

MEASURED (re-measure before planning):
- `/health/read`: apps/daemon/src/http/health-read.ts (150 lines) `HealthView` (:29-48) = {daemon{commandAuthorityPlane, nodeSpecsDir, pid, projectId, protocolVersion, startedAt, storePath}, ledger{aggregates, commandKinds, decisionCount, goals, lastDecidedAt}, outcome:"HEALTH", readAt, verifier}; exact-key consumers: health-read.test.ts and apps/control-room/src/live/live-ops.ts:215 `exactDataRecord(response, ["daemon","ledger","outcome","readAt","verifier"])` (:215-239 builds the HEALTH outcome). Adding a top-level `agents` key = both pins + the control-room HealthOutcome type + every fixture that builds a HEALTH frame (grep `"HEALTH"` under apps/control-room/src --include=*.test.* and name each).
- Screens: Seats = apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/activity-screens.tsx SessionsPanel (:100-140, `cr.sessions.*`, "No agent seat is open right now" :139); Health = ops-screens.tsx:180-206 (cr.health.*); the shell status strip lives in apps/control-room/src/v2/shell/ (context-bar.tsx / shell-model.ts) and is fed by the shell's pollers; the board header next-step for WORKING is goal-status.ts:153-158 ("Watch the board").
- e2e lane: tests/e2e/control-room/playwright.config.ts (`pnpm test:e2e:browser`); the seat double pattern = a scripted `MOE_AGENT_COMMAND` script that prints the verbatim claude limit line to stderr and exits 1 (the wrapper's command is any executable; the launcher's credential gate waives unknown commands - runbook 'Agent credentials').
- Runbook: docs/agent-stack-runbook.md '## Wrapper (staffs the board)' (:352) - the new section '### Provider limits' goes under it.

FEATURE: `HealthView.agents = { paused: null | { provider, resetAt, since, lastLine } }` read from child 1's `readProviderPause` for each known provider (claude, codex) at the daemon's clock; the Seats screen and the shell status strip render "Agents paused: <provider> limit, resumes <local time>" while a pause is live (and the seat-exit receipt's lastLine on Seats); the board header's next-step for a WORKING goal reads "Waiting for the provider limit to reset at <time>" instead of "Watch the board" while paused; the Health screen shows the same fact. Runbook '### Provider limits' documents the roster (by provider, with the sample lines), the bounded default pause, the log line and where it shows in the browser.
definitionOfDone: `/health/read` carries `agents: { paused }` with exact keys (health-read.test.ts pin updated by running it red first; null when no pause, the pause object when one is live at the daemon's clock, and null again after resetAt - three arms over a REAL store using child 1's records); every control-room HEALTH fixture and the live-ops.ts:215 decoder updated and named.

Seats + shell banner + Health tests: with a live pause the Seats screen and the shell strip render 'Agents paused: claude limit, resumes <time>' (time formatted in the viewer's locale from resetAt), the seat-exit lastLine shows on Seats; without a pause nothing of it renders; board header test: a WORKING goal's next-step reads 'Waiting for the provider limit to reset at <time>' while paused and 'Watch the board' otherwise (goal-status.test).

Playwright journey against a REAL daemon + wrapper with a scripted seat double that prints the verbatim claude limit line and exits 1: the pause appears on /health/read within one poll and the banner renders; no second seat spawns before the reset (wrapper log asserted); after the injected reset (a short resetAt in the fixture line or a clock knob child 2 exposes) the item is staffed; `pnpm test:e2e:browser` count line quoted.

docs/agent-stack-runbook.md gains '### Provider limits' under the Wrapper section naming the roster with its sample lines, the 30-minute default, the `[wrapper] provider limit: ...` line and the browser surfaces; gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:e2e:browser`; every production file touched stays under 250 lines (`wc -l` quoted); sources ASCII-only, JSX text apostrophe-free.
taskRails: NO WRAPPER CHANGE: a wrapper gap belongs to child 2 - stop, comment there, report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds.

SHAPE CHANGE NAMED: the HealthView key roster changes exactly once (`agents`), and every exact-key decoder, test pin and fixture that builds a HEALTH frame is listed in the plan before the edit (global rail: grep the SHAPE).
REAL FRAMES ONLY for control-room fixtures; the e2e seat double prints a VERBATIM roster line. Sources ASCII-only, JSX text without apostrophes; <=250 lines per production source.

implementationPlan.description: SPIDR PARENT - VERIFICATION ONLY, NO EDITS. This row was split on 2026-09-04 by architect-16a01670 into four children that carry every edit; this row's dependsOn names them and the runtime withholds it until all four are DONE: 3a task-278faf81c10845ffa571716105aa19e3 (/health/read agents.paused + control-room decoder + Health screen), 3b task-66dc48690fd94b07905a2aa6ffb9568d (app-level pause poll + context + shell strip banner), 3c task-53160801515546259fecc8aa2616acce (Seats banner + board next-step), 3d task-c81cc93d1190496e870816f486c146ae (Playwright journey over the real wrapper + runbook '### Provider limits'). STEP 1 - prove each landed ON DISK, never from the board: for each id `git log main --grep "Moe-Task: <id>" --oneline` (or get_context.epicSiblings[*].landing.merged) and read its completionSummary/reviewSummary; then `grep -n "agents" apps/daemon/src/http/health-read.ts` (the view key), `grep -n '"agents"' apps/control-room/src/live/live-ops.ts` (the decoder roster), `grep -rn "cr.shell.paused\|cr.sessions.paused\|cr.health.agents\|Waiting for the provider limit" apps/control-room/src --include=*.tsx --include=*.ts -l` (four surfaces), `ls tests/e2e/control-room/provider-pause.spec.ts`, `grep -n "### Provider limits" docs/agent-stack-runbook.md`. Any miss -> moe.report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds naming the child that owns it; never patch it here.

STEP 2 - re-run the children's gates READ-ONLY at the delivered tree and quote every count line: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:e2e:browser` (the provider-pause spec must be listed in its output). Walk this row's four DoD sentences one by one and map each to the child arm that discharges it (file + test name); a sentence with no arm is a gap -> comment on the owning child and report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds. Do not add tests here (evidence rows are not their own row - global rail).

STEP 3 - adversarial pass over the WHOLE feature (parent of children 1-3 of task-2723a9b4): a pause recorded for codex while the wrapper runs claude - the read reports codex (KNOWN_PROVIDERS order) and the banner says codex; a pause whose resetAt is past at page load never renders; a detached browser (no session) renders no banner and no crash; the e2e's clearProviderPause path is documented in the runbook as the operator's early-clear recipe. Then `moe.complete_task` with verification = `pnpm test:e2e:browser` and its fresh count line; completionSummary lists the four children with their landed SHAs and the one sentence each surface renders. Report no files (this row owns none); never stage peer WIP, scripts/up.ps1, scripts/watch.ps1 or .moe/messages/*.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: One row for everything - rejected: the measured edit set is ~20 files (daemon read + composition + 2 daemon tests, control-room decoder + 2 fixture files + Health screen, app poll + context + shell + strip + tests, Seats + board + 2 call sites + tests, e2e spec + runbook) against the 10-file hard cap. Split by consumer edge in build order: 3a the read (leaf, only child 1 needed), 3b one app-level poll + context (so no screen polls health twice), 3c the two consumers of the context, 3d the live proof + docs (needs child 2's wrapper too). An app-level context was chosen over per-screen health polls because /health/read walks every decision for lastDecidedAt on each call.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: MEASURED 2026-09-04 at main 9e9b7b04: HealthView health-read.ts:29-49 (exact-key consumer live-ops.ts:215 is the ONLY decoder; HEALTH frames are built in live-ops.test.ts:20-24/:33/:46-47 and ops-screens.test.tsx:31-35 only); the Health screen polls only while mounted (ops/live-ops.tsx:106-110, cordum-app.tsx:323-324) so no shell-wide pause fact exists; deriveGoalStatus input {coverage, goalId, runId, surface} (goal-status.ts:89-94) with two call sites (board-screen.tsx:70, goal-status-strip.tsx:107); SessionsPanel props {nowMs, outcome} (activity-screens.tsx:104); no e2e spec starts the real wrapper (pairing spec stands it in); on win32 the spawner shells `<command> -p ...` so a seat double must be a .cmd ignoring its args; a wall-clock reset cannot be made short, so 3d clears the pause with child 1's clearProviderPause from the spec process.
